From “yes” to shipped, in three steps

No account to create, no cart to manage. Every ring checks out through Stripe, the same payment system trusted by millions of stores.

1

Choose your setting

Pick the style, metal, and diamond shape you want. The price stays the same across every combination.

2

Pay in one click

Buy now opens a secure Stripe checkout with your exact ring already set. Card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay — done in seconds.

3

We ship it, insured

Your ring arrives insured and boxed for the moment it deserves, with a confirmation email the second payment clears.
